Class MyLessonsManualTests

java.lang.Object
testingAutomation.MyLessonsManualTests
public class MyLessonsManualTests extends Object

Title: MyLessonsManualTests Class.

Description: A semi-automated driver for the manual tests of the contributor lesson pages (My Lessons, Add Lesson, and Lesson Detail). These behaviors can only be seen by using the GUI, so this class does not test them itself. Instead it prints each test's setup, steps, and expected result; the tester performs the steps in the running application and answers whether the result matched; and the class tallies the results the same way the automated drivers do.

Requirements tested (from the Contributor user stories):

  • GUI-1: My Lessons shows only the contributor's own lessons, with "Locked" and "Edited by curator" tags (Contributor stories 2 and 4).
  • GUI-2: My Lessons search narrows the list, reports the count, and explains an empty result.
  • GUI-3: Add Lesson stores a valid lesson and refuses invalid input with a field-specific message (Contributor story 1).
  • GUI-4: Lesson Detail saves valid edits; a refused edit changes nothing (Contributor story 1, "I can see and manage it").
  • GUI-5: Lesson Detail deletes only after "Yes", with No as the default, and blocks editing locked fields and deleting a lesson with any lock (Contributor story 2).
  • GUI-6: Lessons added, edited, and deleted in the GUI persist after a restart.

Setup: create two Contributor accounts (for example, jsmith and akim), then run LessonDemoData with the application closed to add the sample lessons. Run this class in its own console, run the application, and follow the prompts.

How to read the output: each test prints its ID, requirement, setup, steps, and expected result, then asks "Did the result match the expected result? (y/n)". Answering y records the test as passed and n as failed. The summary at the end gives the totals; every test should pass.

    • testOwnLessonsWithTags

      static void testOwnLessonsWithTags()

      Test MT-01 (GUI-1, positive): My Lessons shows the contributor's lessons and tags.

      How: the tester logs in as the first demo contributor and opens My Lessons; the page must show that contributor's three demo lessons with the correct tags.

      Output: the steps and expected result, then the tester's y/n answer.

    • testOtherContributorsHidden

      static void testOtherContributorsHidden()

      Test MT-02 (GUI-1, negative): other contributors' lessons are never shown.

      How: the tester logs in as the second demo contributor, then as a contributor with no lessons; neither may see the first contributor's lessons.

      Output: the steps and expected result, then the tester's y/n answer.
